pay_detail: Varies by employer. Each posting sets its own pay.
notes: The site has a Create Your Account link for learners. The page does not state age rules for postings, so check each posting. Ask your school counselor if your school is a partner. The site moved from indianaintern.net to workandlearnindiana.com.
name: Work and Learn Indiana (free internship and work-based learning matching site)
org: Work and Learn Indiana, with the Indiana Commission for Higher Education
what_you_do: A free website where Indiana employers post internships and other work-based learning. Learners search by region and apply. High schools, colleges and employers can join.
who_can_apply: The page says anyone seeking a work-based learning experience, and lists high schools among its partners. It does not state a minimum age. Learners can create an account on the site.
deadline_text: No deadline. Postings come and go, so each one has its own date.
how_to_apply: Make a free learner account on the site. Search for chances by region. Then apply to each one you like.
